corrections.reason: The skill asks kids to match everyday jobs, like opening a door or kicking a ball, to the force being used. That is the push, pull, twist, or squeeze vocabulary taught in g3-sci-force-ways, not just the contact/non-contact sort. g3-sci-force-ways already depends on g3-sci-force-types, so listing force-types directly would be redundant. Replacing it with force-ways keeps the chain direct.

output.notes: Reviewed all 43 proposed Grade 3 skills. Every prerequisite id exists, none point to a later grade or to the skill itself, and no listed prerequisite is a duplicate of another listed prerequisite's dependency chain, except g3-sci-forces-daily (corrected above). Titles and descriptions match their expectations and read well aloud. The remaining prerequisite lists look reasonable as written, though a few are judgment calls (for example, g3-sci-plant-needs for g3-sci-plant-animal-depend), and I left them unchanged.
